title: Heritage – Brückner Journal
content: # “Our pioneering spirit is part of our DNA.”. The Brückner Group’s incredible journey to becoming a global technological leader. The inception: 1960.Brückner Maschinenbau was founded in the Bavarian town of Tittmoning, evolving into a company specializing in stretched films within a short space of time. “Our pioneering spirit is firmly embedded in our DNA,” explains Karlheinz Weinmann, Head of Corporate Communications at Brückner Maschinenbau. Ever since the company was founded, it has pursued the strategy of being at the cutting edge of technology. ### Brückner Maschinenbau. In 2003, Brückner Servtec was added to the portfolio of Brückner Maschinenbau. The company, which was founded in 1945 by Paul Kiefel as a simple bicycle workshop, is now a technology leader in the field of thermoforming and high-frequency welding machines. Extraordinary technological expertise and the will to break new ground have made the Brückner Group a driver of innovation in the industry for many decades.

title: Brückner Maschinenbau
content: The Brückner Group is a family-owned consortium specializing in machine manufacturing and customized engineering solutions and services for the plastics and packaging industry. # For Your Plastic Film of Tomorrow. We are the world’s leading supplier of production lines for the manufacture of stretched films – used as finest packaging material or in high-tech applications. With cutting-edge solutions, a globally unique Technology Center, and deep insight into market needs, we help shaping production environments that are powerful, efficient, and built for lasting success across the entire value chain. ## Always in the Interests of our Customers. Market and feasibility studies, financing, film development, digital solutions or services - we help you in all project phases and - together with Brückner Servtec - throughout the entire life cycle. Thanks to our credo “Stretching the Limits”, as a film manufacturer you benefit from the combined know-how of our experts - whether in mechanical engineering, process engineering or software development.
